entities.summary: Nico Sturm is a German professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Minnesota Wild of the National Hockey League (NHL). He previously played for the Colorado Avalanche, San Jose Sharks and Florida Panthers. He made his NHL debut in 2019 with the Wild, and won the Stanley Cup with the Avalanche in 2022 and the Panthers in 2025. Internationally Sturm has played for the German national team, and won a silver medal at the 2023 World Championships.
